name: linux-basics-i
description: RED-0 aligned labs: CLI, filesystem, pipes, search, and theory quizzes. Easy → medium → hard.
author: Conos

challenges.name: hidden-start
challenges.description: Easy — find what ls hides by default, then unlock the flag with the checker.

challenges.name: shell-theory
challenges.description: Easy — run ./ask and answer CLI basics questions from RED-0 to earn the flag.

challenges.name: path-maze
challenges.description: Medium — absolute vs relative paths and symlink traps across the filesystem.

challenges.name: log-pipeline
challenges.description: Medium — pipes and redirection: filter noisy logs down to the signal.

challenges.name: search-web
challenges.description: Hard — find + grep (+ a touch of head/tail) across a messy tree.

challenges.name: env-theory
challenges.description: Hard — run ./ask for environment variables, man sections, and redirection.
